name: WorkingAPI
description: A searchable directory of 150 free and free-tier public APIs, with official documentation, authentication and CORS notes, example requests, and a scheduled endpoint checker.
notes: Catalogue snapshot dated 2026-10-27. Listings link to provider documentation, but not every endpoint has been directly tested in a live request.
An API being listed does not mean it offers a production SLA, unlimited free usage, or permission for every commercial use.
Authentication, quotas, CORS policies, and provider terms can change. Check the official documentation before using an API in a product.
The initial catalogue is not marked live-verified. GitHub Actions performs low-volume rotating endpoint checks after deployment.

Browser CORS compatibility is separate from server-side reachability and may depend on the requesting Origin. CORS labels marked browser-tested point to the listed test source; other values may be provider-reported, community-reported, or unknown.
For APIs that require keys, never publish private production keys in a static site or public repository. Use a backend or provider-approved key restrictions.
Not every endpoint returns JSON. Some examples return image assets, XML, or plain text, and the examples are written for those response types.
